example.title: City Opera House, Traverse City (1891)
example.place: Traverse City, Grand Traverse County, MI

brief: A three-storey red-brick commercial block with an ornate pressed-metal cornice lettered 'City Opera House', arched windows and shopfronts with awnings below. One photo. Older than 1970: Petoskey's Gaslight District (the town's model) is a row of 1880-1910 brick commercial blocks; no newer example of this main-street type exists. Foundations taken deeper than needed (spec rule 4).
